verdict.rationale: Spending controls are a fair question for a cloud hosting platform like Render, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents hard spending limits, budget caps, or billing alerts. Related items (autoscaling, agent-driven plan changes, migration credits, community pricing comments) are adjacent and do not show a cost-limit capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can set hard spending limits to control my cloud costs
